[[Riverside Province (outpost)|Riverside Province]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]].

==Getting There==
*You can enter Riverside Province from [[Twin Serpent Lakes]].
*The quest [[Passage Through The Dark River]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[Riverside Province]]
**This mission is the thirteenth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the fourth mission in the [[Kryta]] region.
